restaurants.name: 1910 Restaurant & Bar Miami Lakes
restaurants.blurb: Located in the heart of Miami Lakes, 1910 Restaurant & Bar is a family-owned restaurant inspired by the elegance and glamour of the 1910 era, offering a unique international fusion of steakhouse, seafood, Italian, Cuban, Latin, and American cuisine. Known for its charcoal-grilled specialties, wood-fired pizzas, handmade pastas, premium steaks, and fresh seafood, 1910 has quickly become one of the area’s most celebrated dining destinations. Guests enjoy an upscale yet welcoming atmosphere featuring live violin and saxophone performances, soft live music, a full-service bar, elegant indoor dining, and a beautiful outdoor patio. With experienced chefs, exceptional hospitality, and a passion for culinary excellence, 1910 Restaurant & Bar delivers an unforgettable dining experience that embodies The Art of Dining.

restaurants.name: 94th Aero Squadron Restaurant
restaurants.blurb: The 94th Aero Squadron Restaurant in Miami offers a distinctive dining experience that combines aviation history with a diverse menu. Overlooking the runway of Miami International Airport, guests can enjoy views of planes taking off and landing, with headphones available at each table to listen to live air traffic control communications. The restaurant's design emulates a World War I-era French farmhouse, complete with vintage military memorabilia, providing a unique and immersive atmosphere. The menu features a variety of American and international dishes, including steakhouse classics, seafood, and pasta. The restaurant also offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, and happy hour services.

restaurants.name: A Fish Called Avalon
restaurants.blurb: Located in the historic Art Deco District, A Fish Called Avalon specializes in seafood with tropical influences. Enjoy your meal in our beautiful dining room, which has floor to ceiling windows with views of world-famous Ocean Drive. Dine on our terrace, where live music and ocean breezes set a sophisticated and authentic South Beach experience. The dinner menu includes a raw bar, as well as macadamia-crusted snapper and an orzo seafood paella among many other seafood bestsellers. Other non-seafood options include ribeye, vegetarian pasta, and a free-range citrus chicken. There is a full bar and an award-winning wine list. Dinner Hours: 5:00 - to 10:30 pm Mon-Wed & 5:00 - to 11:00 pm Thu-Sun Happy Hour: 3:00 to 7:00 pm Daily Enjoy luscious libations and a selection of some signature appetizers at the bar, seven days a week from 3:00 to 7:00 p.m. Live music daily. Reservations are highly suggested. Culinary excellence Since 1989. Public parking garage located on 7th Street between Washington and Collins Avenue. Valet Parking Option - 3 hours for $10.

restaurants.name: A Love Story Winery and Bistro
restaurants.blurb: Enjoy a curated selection of wines and international bistro style cuisine at A Love Story Winery & Bistro. Situated a stone's throw away from 2000 acres of farmland known as "Horse Country", A Love Story Winery & Bistro is in a perfect location in the midst of an agricultural oasis yet easily accessible from anywhere in the city. The venue features an entrance/porch, dining area, wine tasting room and cigar lounge, terrace and gardens.

special_offers.title: Wine Pairing Dinner
special_offers.description_html:
Discover the world of wine through an exclusive Wine Pairing Dinner led by the restaurant's in-house sommelier. This immersive tasting experience features six thoughtfully selected wines from renowned wine regions around the world, each expertly paired with a variety of tapas that complement the evening's featured selections. Wine offerings rotate monthly, making every event a unique experience.

Most wine tastings are conducted in Spanish. English-language tastings are available upon request, and the sommeliers are happy to provide translation throughout the experience as needed. Guests are also invited to inquire about Wine Club membership opportunities.

Price: $75 per person (plus tax and a 22% service charge)
How to Book: Call (305) 200-5262 and request the Wine Pairing Dinner at the special Miami Spice price.
Dates Offered: August 12, September 9, and September 16, 2026
Experience Location: Basement Cellar of A Love Story
Restrictions & Blackout Dates: Available only on the specified dates. The experience begins Wednesdays at 7:45 p.m. Advance reservations are required and subject to availability.

restaurants.name: A Pasta Bar
restaurants.blurb: A Pasta Bar brings its acclaimed SoHo concept to Miami Beach’s Sunset Harbour neighborhood, offering a contemporary Italian dining experience centered around handmade pasta and an immersive open-kitchen design. Built around a striking central island kitchen and 20-seat chef’s counter, the restaurant invites guests into the heart of the culinary process, where fresh pasta is crafted daily and finished with precision in full view of the dining room. The menu blends Italian tradition with modern influences, featuring signature pastas, crudo selections, wood-grilled meats, seasonal seafood, and a curated five-course pasta tasting experience designed for sharing. Guests can also enjoy a Milanese-style aperitivo hour, inventive Italian-inspired cocktails, and an exclusively Italian wine list. Designed with rich materials, vintage Italian furnishings, and a vibrant indoor-outdoor atmosphere, A Pasta Bar offers a lively yet refined dining destination in the heart of Sunset Harbour.

restaurants.name: ADRIFT Mare by David Myers
restaurants.blurb: ADRIFT Mare is a Mediterranean restaurant and cocktail bar curated by Michelin-starred ‘Gypsy Chef™’ David Myers at the sophisticated urban retreat Brickell Arch Hotel in Miami. Perched on the 25th floor, offering stunning views of Biscayne Bay, Enjoy our terrace or private dining for a memorable experience, perfect for any occasion. Experience unparalleled cuisine, panoramic views and an unmatched ambience at ADRIFT Mare. ADRIFT Mare brings together the elegance of the French Riviera, the laid back vibe of the Balearic islands, the vibrancy of fresh Italian produce, warm Levant hospitality and the gentle rhythm of the Greek Isles.

restaurants.name: AVA Coconut Grove
restaurants.blurb: AVA MediterrAegean redefines coastal dining in Coconut Grove, offering an immersive journey where Mediterranean elegance meets vibrant, modern energy. Guided by the spirit of PAREA, AVA is more than a destination—it is a celebration of connection, beauty, and life itself. Each detail is designed to evoke a sense of escape, where exceptional cuisine and atmosphere converge to create something truly unforgettable. Open daily for dinner, with brunch available every Saturday and Sunday.

special_offers.title: MediterrAegean Chef's Tasting Experience
special_offers.description_html:
Embark on an eight-course tasting journey celebrating the vibrant flavors of the Mediterranean at AVA MediterrAegean. Crafted for a minimum of two guests, this chef-curated experience begins with an amuse-bouche before progressing through seasonal mezze, premium seafood, signature entrées, and thoughtfully paired sides, culminating with the restaurant's classic baklava. Designed to showcase AVA's elevated approach to Mediterranean cuisine, each course highlights fresh ingredients, bold flavors, and refined culinary techniques.

Amuse-Bouche

  • Chef's Selection

Starters

  • Crispy Zucchini – Tempura squash blossom, tzatziki
  • Hummus – Tahini, crispy chickpeas, olive oil, crispy lavash
  • Tuna Ceviche – Avocado, cherry tomato, calamansi vinegar

Main Courses

  • Half Rack of Lamb – Pistachio za'atar vierge, charred lemon, herb salad
  • Grilled Whole Branzino – Mojo verde, lemon

Sides

  • Crisp Patatas – Marble potatoes, oregano, lemon
  • Broccolini – Mojo verde, crispy shallots

Dessert

  • Baklava

Price: $120 per person
How to Book: Reservations are required and may be made online through OpenTable.
Days Offered: Every evening from August 1 through September 30 during Miami Spice Months
Experience Location: AVA MediterrAegean Coconut Grove
Restrictions: Minimum of two guests is required. Reservations are subject to availability. Taxes and gratuity are not included.

restaurants.name: Amazonico
restaurants.blurb: Amazónico Miami brings the pulse of Latin America to the heart of Brickell with a three-story dining and nightlife experience designed to transport guests into a world of tropical glamour, elevated cuisine, and nonstop energy. Inspired by the richness of the Amazon rainforest and the vibrant spirit of 1970s Rio de Janeiro, Amazónico blends immersive design, world-class hospitality, and globally influenced Latin American flavors into one of Miami’s most sought-after destinations. From the moment guests arrive, they are surrounded by lush greenery, woven textures, volcanic stone, dramatic lighting, and curated music that evolves throughout the night. The ground-floor restaurant offers an open-kitchen concept where diners can experience the theater of live-fire cooking, fresh seafood, premium meats, and vibrant Amazon-inspired dishes while live jazz, bossa nova, and Cuban rhythms create an unforgettable atmosphere. Upstairs, the Bar & Lounge transforms the experience into a high-energy social escape, featuring a signature sushi counter, expertly crafted tropical cocktails, mirrored ceilings, and resident DJs alongside live percussion performances. Every detail is designed to blur the line between fine dining and nightlife, making Amazónico equally ideal for intimate dinners, celebratory evenings, and late-night experiences. Crowning the venue is its iconic rooftop, an open-air destination that captures the electric spirit of Miami after dark. With skyline views, a dramatic peacock-inspired bar, immersive lighting, and a music-driven ambiance, the rooftop delivers an effortlessly sophisticated setting for cocktails, private events, and unforgettable nights in Brickell. As the first U.S. location of the internationally acclaimed Amazónico brand — with celebrated venues in Madrid, London, Dubai, and Monte Carlo — Amazónico Miami has quickly established itself as a premier destination where luxury dining, entertainment, and culture converge under one roof.

restaurants.name: Aromas Del Peru Coral Gables
restaurants.blurb: Aromas del Peru is a culinary landmark with multiple locations across Miami, proudly known as one of the pioneers of traditional Peruvian cuisine in the city. Rooted in the rich heritage of Peru’s Costa, Sierra, and Selva regions, we have passionately introduced the flavors of our homeland to the world—celebrating the depth of our culinary traditions while embracing creative innovation. Our menu honors the authentic Creole classics that define Peruvian comfort food, while also showcasing a modern fusion of cultures that have shaped our gastronomy—Andean, African, Chinese, Japanese, and European influences come together in bold, flavorful, and beautifully crafted dishes. At Aromas, we believe that food is a cultural experience. That’s why we take pride in using high-quality ingredients, traditional techniques, and heartfelt hospitality to offer every guest a taste of Peru’s culinary soul. Whether you're enjoying a beloved traditional plate or one of our elevated signature creations, every dish tells a story—of our roots, our people, and our evolution. Come experience Aromas del Peru, where tradition meets innovation, and every meal feels like coming home.

restaurants.name: Azabu Miami Beach
restaurants.blurb: Standing out in the sea of critically-acclaimed restaurants and bars that call Miami Beach home is no small task, but Azabu Miami Beach manages to do exactly that. A Unique Dining Experience in the Heart of Miami Beach The first thing to know about Azabu Miami Beach is that it’s unlike any other restaurant or bar in the city, offering a spectrum of experiences under a single, stylish roof. There are three separate but connected spaces within the venue, each one united by incredible food, drinks, and service. First is the full-service dining room, where diners can take a front-row seat to the chefs’ culinary prowess thanks to the large, open kitchen. Just steps beyond the dining room is The Den , a hidden gem where Tokyo-trained sushi chefs craft some of the best sashimi and sushi in Miami . Finally, Bar Azabu is the venue’s classic cocktail bar, serving the best sakes in the world and more than 40 different imported whiskeys. Azabu Miami Beach also hosts private events and provides off-site catering , going above and beyond to deliver on their signature omotenashi promise.

restaurants.name: Bagatelle Miami River
restaurants.blurb: At Bagatelle Miami River, the spirit of the French Riviera comes alive through a blend of sophistication and playful elegance. Inspired by St. Tropez, the waterfront space is filled with natural light, lush greenery, and curated French details, from artwork to cabanas, creating a transportive escape along the Miami River. Bagatelle comes to life from day into night with refined dinner service, lively evenings, and the iconic Bagatelle Sundays, featuring a rotating DJ lineup that sets the tone for an elevated brunch-to-party experience. Wednesday - Saturday, as the sun begins to set, guests are invited to discover Sunset Offerings along the river. Sunset Hour is a relaxed early-evening ritual at the outdoor bar, featuring $2 oysters, seafood bites, champagne by the glass, and signature cocktails. For those seeking a seated dining experience, Sunset Dinner offers a three-course pre-fixe menu of signature favorites with optional wine pairings. Whether dining indoors, enjoying al fresco river views, or gathering for brunch and late-night energy, Bagatelle Miami River delivers a vibrant, ever-evolving experience that captures Miami’s global spirit with the charm of the South of France. Dinner: Wednesday & Thursday | 6pm - 1:30am Friday & Saturday | 6pm - 2:30am Sunset Hour - Happy Hour Menu: Wednesday - Saturday | 6pm - 7:30pm Bagatelle Sunday Brunch Sunday | 12pm - 10:30pm

The 6,972-square-foot indoor and outdoor restaurant transports guests to Mexico with its earthy, artsy and modern space, wide variety of authentic regional dishes, expansive mezcal and tequila offerings and handcrafted tortilla selection. Every inch of the space conveys a fun, lively and warm environment to enjoy a true Mexican experience, from the open-view kitchen allowing guests to witness the art of handcrafted tortilla making to the four-tiered glass case filled with more than 350 mezcals and tequilas and more. Bakan is open for lunch and dinner daily and offers a menu made with fresh, artisenal ingredients.

restaurants.name: Barsecco
restaurants.blurb: Barsecco is a stylish restaurant & lounge that transforms from bright and open to sensual and inviting by night. Enter just off Brickell Avenue onto the breezy canopied terrace where eclectic seating, draping vines and reclaimed barn wood welcome guests to mingle, dine and relax. Inside, plush interiors, towering tree and low lighting lend a seductive edge to an otherwise cozy space. As lights dim and cocktails are poured, a warm, social dining experience is encouraged with shared-plates drawn from diverse cultures and a local twist. Here, classic & creative cocktails highlight fresh ingredients, along with beers, bottle service, and an international selection of spirits, wine and champagne. In the later hours, programming infuses energy to ensure the mood is right for a convivial night fueled by cocktails, music and late-night bites. Canta Corazón Barsecco is turning up the volume with the debut of Canta Corazón, a new interactive nightlife experience launching April 16, 2026, in Brickell. Designed for big energy and crowd participation, Canta Corazón puts guests in the middle of the action with sing-along moments, live DJ sets, and a soundtrack packed with Latin favorites and iconic English hits. Happening Thursday through Saturday nights , the new concept is made for birthdays, group nights out, and unforgettable celebrations, with signature food, drinks, and surprise moments that keep the party going. Reservations are available via OpenTable. For updates and event content, follow: @barsecco and @cantacorazon.miami

restaurants.name: Bayshore Club
restaurants.blurb: Welcome to Bayshore Club - built on the historic site known as Dinner Key and part of Miami's oldest neighborhood, Coconut Grove. Originally an island and later connected to the mainland in 1914, Dinner Key received its name for being a beautiful picnic stop while traveling by boat along the coastal waters of the city. In 1918 it became the site of the first continental naval air station in the United States until the end of WWI. Through the 1930’s and 40’s, Dinner Key served as a base for Pan American World Airway’s flying boats, the Sikorsky S41 and S42 (commonly known as Clipper planes). The planes were once housed in the newly restored hangers at Bayshore Club and the original Art Deco airport terminal is now the site Miami City Hall located to the southeast side of the restaurant.

restaurants.name: Beauty and The Butcher
restaurants.blurb: Beauty and the Butcher, in Coral Gables. Ford, who earned a Michelin star for the critically-acclaimed restaurant Stubborn Seed, will showcase his culinary prowess at Beauty and the Butcher with a menu that will focus on rotating seasonal small plates and a selection of different meats. Beauty and the Butcher is a nod to Ford's relationship with his eldest daughter, Madelynn (the beauty), and himself (the butcher). For more information follow @beautyandthebutchermiami. Beauty & the Butcher features an expansive modern dining room with seating for 160, including 30 seats at the bar, and blends contemporary decor with the comforts of home. A smooth gray-veined quartz bar anchors the space and wraps around a display of dry-aging meats. Warm earth-toned woods and glittering bronze accents are found throughout and tabletops and dining chairs alternate between white quartz, honey and caramel hues. Cozy booths are upholstered in forest green leather and are juxtaposed with artfully-decorated bookshelves. Soft lighting from the room’s brass-toned chandeliers emit an inviting glow that runs through the floor-to-ceiling windows out onto the street corner. Tucked away at the back of the restaurant, a private dining room with seating for up to 30 sitting or 60 cocktail-style allows for intimate private events. The exterior of the restaurant features natural elements including red oak wood and limestone, with bronze metal framing the corner entrance to the restaurant.

restaurants.blurb: Bella celebrates the unfiltered joy, strength, and warmth of Southern Italy. Inspired by Chef Eyal Shani’s admiration for the region, its culture, its women, its markets, its elemental flavors, Bella expresses Italian tradition through a Mediterranean point of view. Bella is both a character and a culinary philosophy. She’s the Italian woman who has been stirring pots, rolling pasta, and feeding people her entire life. Warm. Confident. Vibrant. Her spirit shapes the food, the atmosphere, and the way guests are welcomed. At Liberty Park Hotel, Bella becomes something new: Italian warmth, Mediterranean craft, and Miami Beach electricity served under sunlight and starlight.

restaurants.name: Bistro Collins
restaurants.blurb: Welcome to Bistro Collins The distinctive new culinary centerpiece of Loews Miami Beach Hotel - a stylish dining destination that exemplifies American coastal bistro cuisine. Inspired by the inviting spirit of bistro culture, here timeless technique blends with the vibrant, locally-driven flavors of Latin America and the Caribbean. The result is an elevated take on beloved classics, alongside fresh, inspired dishes destined to become new favorites. Classic Roots. Coastal Soul. At Bistro Collins, we celebrate the balance of simplicity and creativity. Where thoughtful sourcing, seasonal ingredients and culinary craftsmanship come together on every plate. Dishes like Croque Madame Fritters, classic Steak Tartare and delicate handmade pastas share the table with Roasted Prawns with aji panca, Braised Beef Empanadas and bright island-inspired salads. Refined yet approachable, familiar yet unexpected, our menu pays homage to tradition while embracing the colorful flavors that define Miami’s culinary landscape. Complementing our American coastal bistro cuisine is an imaginative cocktail program, featuring artful mixology that celebrates globally inspired spirits. Whether beginning your stay, indulging in a leisurely evening or soaking in the energy of South Beach, Bistro Collins invites you to savor a dining experience that feels refined, relaxed and undeniably Miami.

restaurants.name: Blind Tiger
restaurants.blurb: Blind Tiger is a Speakeasy Japanese restaurant located inside Reunion Ktchn & Bar, offering a high quality Omakase, or a-la-carte, experience. Blind Tiger was inspired by the speakeasy concept that was born during the prohibition era in the USA. It is a secret place, exclusive, but unpretentious, minimal decoration, where the food is the star. A sophisticated Japanese cuisine experience but with a modern interpretation, with a quality-driven menu curated to activate your senses and focusing on the food. Blind Tiger is the reimagination of a traditional sushi from traditional nigiri, sashimi or maki to more adventurous sushi combinations. No matter their menu choices, all guests of Blind Tiger can indulge in a high-quality Japanese experience.

restaurants.blurb: Bocatto Trattoria: An Authentic Italian Escape in North Miami Experience the true soul of Italy in the heart of North Miami at Bocatto Trattoria, offering the convenience of free parking for all our guests. We pride ourselves on crafting nearly all our dishes in-house, meticulously caring for every detail of the culinary process—beginning with the selection of top-quality ingredients to celebrate traditional Italian flavors with a modern, sophisticated touch. From perfectly al dente specialty pastas to expertly crafted risottos and fresh-from-the-oven dishes, every plate is designed to offer a memorable journey. Whether you are looking for an intimate dinner, a vibrant spot to celebrate with friends, or simply a place to savor exceptional ingredients in a welcoming atmosphere, Bocatto Trattoria provides an authentic dining experience. Join us for a taste of tradition, exceptional service, and the warm hospitality that makes every guest feel like family.

restaurants.name: Bouchon Bistro
restaurants.blurb: Chef Keller’s award-winning French bistro, Bouchon, occupies the historic La Palma building, constructed in 1924, formerly home to one of the longest-standing hotels in the city. The Mediterranean-style exterior with a beautiful central courtyard encompasses the restaurant, designed by long-time Bouchon collaborator Adam D. Tihany of Tihany Design in New York City, who worked on both Bouchon restaurants in Yountville and Las Vegas. The menu offers seasonally changing classic French dishes, such as roast chicken, steak frites, and croque madame. It also includes the signature raw bar, featuring a selection of fruits de mer, complemented by an extensive French and domestic wine list, along with traditional cocktails.

restaurants.name: Boulud Sud
restaurants.blurb: Boulud Sud is Chef Daniel Boulud’s vibrant celebration of the sun and the sea. Drawing inspiration from the coastal Mediterranean, including France’s Côte d’Azur, Spain, Italy, Greece, Morocco, Tunisia, Lebanon, Israel, and Turkey the menu emphasizes regional flavors, featuring an abundance of fresh vegetables, seafood, grains and herbs. The restaurant has been completely renovated in jewel tones and soft fabrics to create a relaxing and casual atmosphere. Boulud Sud also boasts an exceptional cocktail program that actively pulls from the same seasonal products found on the food menu and Our bar/lounge serves food continuously from noon and features a happy hour from 5 to 8pm (excluding weekends). Situated in the JW Marriott Marquis and across the street from the newly opened Silverspot Theatres, Boulud Sud is conveniently located within walking distance of American Airlines Arena, the Perez Art Museum, Brickell City Centre, and all that Downtown Miami has to offer.

It's the perfect place to eat, drink, and share in the true spirit of Spanish hospitality.

restaurants.name: Calle Dragones Miami
restaurants.blurb: A tribute to Cuba and its Cultural influences. Calle Dragones, already a success in Bogota and Cartagena (Colombia), resembles the street in Havana that bears its name and collides with Calle Zanja, dividing the Chinese neighborhood from the rest of Havana. Originally invented by Chinese migrants brought to Cuba as laborers in the 1850's, Asian Latin cuisine blended Chinese and Caribbean ingredients and cooking techniques. The Cuban Revolution in 1959, however, got in the way and deprived the world to meet what was meant to be today's Cuban cuisine. Many left the island and concentrated in Miami and New York. Havana's Chinatown is still one of the oldest and largest in the Americas.

restaurants.name: Casa Neos
restaurants.blurb: CASA NEOS Restaurant is a delightful culinary journey that goes beyond indulgence. Offering a delicious modern cuisine, inspired by the shores of the Mediterranean. restaurants.name: Casadonna
restaurants.blurb: Casadonna is a coastal Italian-inspired waterfront restaurant developed in partnership between Groot Hospitality and Tao Group Hospitality. It is housed in the same Mediterranean Revival building as Miami’s historic women’s club, located in the city’s burgeoning Edgewater neighborhood. In fact, the name “Casadonna” is derived from the setting-it is a fusion of Italian words translating to “house of the woman" Riviera-style Italian cooking serves as the heart of Casadonna’s cuisine. The menu features the freshest and finest local and imported products, with signature handcrafted dishes. Plates are based around traditional recipes found in the coastal towns of Naples, Taormina, Bari, Positano, and Gaeta, and each is presented in a contemporary fashion. Bespoke cocktails and an extensive wine list will complement this approach

restaurants.name: Celias Kitchen and Social Bar
restaurants.blurb: Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar: Miami's Taste of Tradition & Twist Born in 1926 inside The Watson Hotel, Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar has always mirrored Miami's pulse. What beg, n as a tropical hideaway grew bolder in 1959, when Cuban newcomers infused the city-and our kitchen-with their rich culinary heritage. Today, this cool, modern spot is the city's go-to place to socialize, grab a craft drink, and indulge ir delicious Cuban-fusion plates. Led by next-gen chefs who blend abuela's secrets with global flair, every bite tells a story-whether it's our award-winning Cuban Sandwich, Yucca-Stuffed Shrimp, or sky-high Pan con Bistec. At the bar, Havana beats on: mojitos bursting with fresh-picked fruit, Floridita-style daiquiris, and the smoky Caballero Old Fashioned keep the fiesta flowing from lunch to late night. History, innovation, community-served hot and shaken cold. Welcome home to Celia's Kitchen and Social Bar, whe e Miami's past meets its delicious, social future.

Our menu features premium steaks, fresh seafood, shareable appetizers, and house-made desserts, offering something for every occasion. Catch the game in our energetic lounge with multiple TVs, unwind on the covered outdoor patio, or join us for weekend brunch every Saturday and Sunday from 11 AM–3 PM. Just minutes from Downtown Miami and close to Coconut Grove’s top attractions, Chop delivers an approachable, upscale dining experience that’s perfect for everything from casual drinks to memorable dinners.

restaurants.blurb: Located in the heart of Miami, CLAUDIE restaurant is a celebration of the timeless elegance and charm of the South of France. Inspired by "la cuisine du soleil," made famous by Roger Vergé, our menu showcases vibrant Mediterranean flavors infused with the essence of the Côte d'Azur. We craft dishes using the finest ingredients, blending tradition and creativity in an elevated bistronomy setting. Paired with five-star service and warm hospitality, every moment here is designed to delight. restaurants.name: Cote Miami
restaurants.blurb: Since February 2021, the Miami outpost of Michelin-starred and James Beard Award nominated Korean Steakhouse COTE NYC has been serving elevated Korean cuisine in Miami’s Design District. The 5,892-square-foot restaurant combines the bold flavors of Korean barbecue with the classic vibe of an American steakhouse. The result is a fine dining experience featuring top-notch service, world-class ingredients and a show-stopping beverage program. Helmed by executive chef David Shim, COTE’s signature menu items include 45-day, USDA prime dry-aged beef with nutrient-dense, probiotic-rich side dishes; a Butcher’s Feast with chef’s choice of four selected cuts of meat accompanied by an assortment of Korean side dishes; and an elevated Steak Omakase experience. The sleek, intimate, 100+ seat dining area features smokeless state-of-the-art tabletop grills at every table. There is also an elaborate dry-aging room and two private dining rooms. COTE’s 1200+ label wine list was nominated for “Outstanding Wine Program” two consecutive years in a row by the James Beard Foundation and also awarded Florida Sommelier. Other notable awards include the 2022 MICHELIN Guide Florida Star Revelation which recognizes the COTE brand as one of the only two restaurants in the United States with MICHELIN stars in multiple cities.

restaurants.name: DOYA
restaurants.blurb: DOYA is a modern Aegean Meze + Bar restaurant, located in the heart of Wynwood. Inspired by the Grecian and Turkish Meze culture, DOYA embraces the principle that food tastes better when shared with people you love. Doya's meat and vegetable dishes are prepared over wood fire and coals with flavors from the greater Mediterranean region and the Middle East. Recently awarded a Michelin Bob Gourmand, DOYA's menu features a flavorful selection of cold and hot meze dishes prepared from ingredients that are seasonal and of the highest quality. Doya is open 7 days a week serving lunch and dinner. Guests have the option of dining indoors where the restaurant's extensive bar is located or outdoor in the lush, garden area.

special_offers.title: A Dinner with the Chef
special_offers.description_html:
Join the culinary team at DOYA for A Dinner with the Chef, an intimate chef's table experience where exceptional cuisine, handcrafted cocktails, and personal interaction come together for an unforgettable evening.

Limited to just 12 guests, this exclusive family-style dinner features five cold dishes, five hot dishes, and three desserts, accompanied by two expertly crafted cocktails. Throughout the evening, the chef will join the table to share the inspiration, techniques, and stories behind each course, creating a truly immersive dining experience.

restaurants.name: Da Angelino
restaurants.blurb: The brainchild of two South Florida hospitality powerhouses, Graspa Group and Ariete Hospitality Group, Da Angelino Cucina Italiana brings Italian tradition to life. More than a restaurant, Da Angelino is a love letter to Italy, offering house-made pasta, freshly prepared meats and seafood and thoughtfully curated wines from Italy and beyond. Located inside CocoWalk in Coconut Grove, the space blends upscale elegance with Italian charm, featuring crisp white linen tablecloths, warm terra-cotta and sage tones, and a garden-style patio for alfresco dining. Guided by and named for Florence-born hospitality veteran Angelo Kometa, Da Angelino captures the warmth and convivial spirit of Italian family gatherings with a touch of Miami charm.

restaurants.name: Daniel's Miami

The menu showcases an elevated steak program featuring premium cuts sourced from renowned producers around the world, complemented by fresh local seafood, classic Italian specialties, and thoughtfully crafted selections for vegetarians and seafood enthusiasts alike. Led by GIOIA Hospitality Founder and CEO Tom Angelo, Managing Director Kassidy Angelo, Culinary Director Danny Ganem, Executive Chef Dayam Lopez, and Wine & Beverage Director Daniel Bishop, the restaurant delivers an exceptional dining experience rooted in European-style hospitality, attention to detail, and personalized service. Guests seeking a more relaxed experience can enjoy the dedicated Daniel’s Bar menu, offering signature dishes, cocktails, and wines in an inviting lounge setting enhanced with televisions and comfortable seating. The space features iconic artwork and sophisticated design elements that create an atmosphere both elegant and welcoming. In addition, guests can look forward to Daniel’s award-winning wine program and celebrated wine dinners, signature experiences that have become hallmarks of the GIOIA Hospitality name.

restaurants.name: Drinking Pig
restaurants.blurb: Located in the heart of Coconut Grove, Drinking Pig BBQ puts a Miami spin on classic American barbecue with a menu that blends slow-smoked Southern traditions and bold Caribbean flavors. Founded by Chef Raheem Sealey, the restaurant began as a popular pop-up before becoming a neighborhood favorite known for expertly smoked brisket, ribs, pulled pork and house-made sausages, paired with creative island-inspired sides and award-winning sauces. The casual, walk-in-only smokehouse offers a welcoming atmosphere for locals and visitors alike, making it a great stop for lunch or dinner after exploring Coconut Grove. Whether you're craving tender smoked meats, comforting barbecue classics or a uniquely Miami take on traditional BBQ, Drinking Pig BBQ delivers an unforgettable dining experience.

special_offers.title: Miami Spice BBQ Platter
special_offers.description_html:
Experience the bold flavors of Drinking Pig BBQ with a shareable barbecue feast created exclusively for Miami Spice. This signature platter features a curated selection of the restaurant's slow-smoked meats, paired with house-made sides that showcase the authentic flavors and time-honored techniques behind Drinking Pig's award-winning barbecue.

Whether you're discovering Drinking Pig for the first time or returning for your favorites, this exclusive experience offers a delicious way to sample the best of Coconut Grove's beloved barbecue destination.

Experience Price (Per Person): $25
How to Book: No reservations required. Drinking Pig BBQ is first-come, first-served. Simply visit during Miami Spice Months and ask for the Miami Spice BBQ Platter.
Dates Offered: August 1 – September 30, 2026
Experience Location: Coconut Grove
Restrictions & Blackout Dates: Available while supplies last. First-come, first-served. Dine-in only. Tax and gratuity not included.

restaurants.name: E41 - Embarcadero 41 Brickell
restaurants.blurb: Experience the vibrant flavors of Peru at Embarcadero 41 Brickell, where the rich traditions of Peruvian cuisine meet the precision and artistry of Japanese culinary techniques. Specializing in Peruvian Nikkei cuisine, the restaurant showcases the evolution of Peru's celebrated gastronomy through fresh ceviches, tiraditos, sushi, grilled seafood and premium meats, all crafted with high-quality ingredients and bold, balanced flavors. Located in the heart of Brickell, Embarcadero 41 offers a warm, contemporary atmosphere ideal for lunch, happy hour or dinner. Signature cocktails, attentive hospitality and an inviting ambiance complement the menu, creating a memorable dining experience for locals and visitors seeking one of Miami's most exciting culinary traditions

special_offers.title: Family-Style Dining Experience
special_offers.description_html:
Bring people together over a shared dining experience at E41 Brickell. Designed to encourage conversation and connection, this Signature Dining Experience features a family-style menu with appetizers, entrées, and desserts served in the center of the table for everyone to enjoy.

Ideal for corporate gatherings, networking events, birthdays, and special celebrations, this communal dining experience transforms every meal into a memorable occasion centered around exceptional food and shared moments.

Price: $90 per person (plus applicable sales tax and a 20% service charge)
How to Book: Reserve through OpenTable. Reservations are subject to OpenTable's Terms & Conditions.
Dates Offered: Through September 30, 2026
Experience Location: E41 Brickell
Restrictions & Blackout Dates: Available for groups of 10–30 guests. A credit card is required to confirm the reservation, and a 50% deposit will be charged and applied toward the final balance. Deposits are fully refundable for cancellations received at least 48 hours before the event. Cancellations made within 48 hours are non-refundable. Additional gratuity is optional.

restaurants.name: Estiatorio Milos
restaurants.blurb: Located in South Beach’s South of Fifth neighborhood, Estiatorio Milos is renowned for excellent fish and seafood and a refined approach to Greek cuisine. The fresh seafood selection is shipped daily from the Mediterranean. The menu offerings include Greek ceviche, grilled octopus, and Greek favorites like skordalia, grilled vegetables, and hummus. If you’re not in the mood for seafood, there are other options like ribeye, filet mignon and lamb. Impeccable service, convivial family-style sharing and exciting tableside food preparation provide an unforgettable and truly exceptional dining experience. For reservations, call the restaurant directly at (305) 604-6800. Lunch is served daily from 12 pm to 3 pm. Dinner is served Sunday to Thursday from 5:30 - 10 p.m., and Friday - Saturday from 5:30 - 10:30 p.m. Visit estiatoriomilos.com for menus and more information.

The menu includes delectable cuts of fire-roasted meats such as sizzling steaks, lamb, chicken and pork carved tableside by Brazilian trained gaucho chefs that prepare and cook each cut. Ingredient driven using local artisan purveyors, the restaurant encompasses traditional Indian home cooking.

special_offers.title: Exclusive Wine Tasting Experience
special_offers.description_html:
Discover one of Miami Beach's premier wine experiences with an Exclusive Wine Tasting Experience at the Wine Counter inside Hakkasan at Fontainebleau Miami Beach. Guided by expert sommeliers, this intimate tasting showcases a curated flight selected from Fontainebleau's award-winning wine program, featuring exceptional vintages from a collection of more than 1,000 acclaimed wines from around the world.

The tasting is complemented by a selection of Michelin-recognized bites from Hakkasan, thoughtfully paired to enhance the unique flavors, aromas, and textures of each wine. Whether you're a seasoned wine enthusiast or new to the world of wine, this immersive experience offers a refined introduction to the art of wine and food pairing.

restaurants.name: Havana 1957 - Ocean Drive
restaurants.blurb: Located on Ocean Drive, Havana 1957 creates a unique dining experience that allows you relive the glory and glamour of Old Cuba during the 1950s. Find authentic Cuban cuisine, live Cuban music, and vintage memorabilia in the main dining room. If you prefer to do some people-watching, the outside patio will not disappoint. The menu offers a variety of Cuban favorites, like croquetas, media noche sandwich, picadillo and grilled grouper. Wash it down with a traditional mojito, and finish everything off with a shot of Cuban espresso. Make your reservation online or call 305-515-0723 Hours are Sunday to Thursday from 9 a.m. to 1 a.m., Friday and Saturday till 2 a.m. This restaurant also serves breakfast . Check out our website to learn about special holiday menus, like the New Year’s Eve Gala .

restaurants.name: Joe's Stone Crab Restaurant
restaurants.blurb: Before the glitz and glamour that has become "SoBe," Joe's Stone Crab Restaurant stood as a spot for true seafood-loving locals and tourists alike. Established in 1913, two years before Miami Beach would even become incorporated, Joe’s has withstood the test of time. Opened as "Joe's Restaurant" by Joe and Jennie Weiss, local seafood was served up on their front porch after being prepared in their kitchen. Move forward to 1920, when a Harvard ichthyologist brought an unknown crustacean to Joe’s. Joe threw the crab into boiling water and, voila! Stone crabs were discovered. They have dominated not only the menu at Joe’s Stone Crab , but have been a Miami staple ever since. Fast-forward more than 100 years and Joe's has held its place as the leader in stone crabs, fresh seafood and, since its partnership with a Florida cattle ranch, outstanding steaks. From the moment you approach the grandeur of the restaurant (it sits on the corner of South Pointe Drive and Washington Avenue, enveloping most of the block), you can see the attention to detail that is prevalent in the atmosphere, which leads to the incredible dining experience you'll enjoy. A lush and peaceful outside patio greets you. If you’d like to stay outside you can relax on Joe's patio, where the full menu is served. A Seafood Dining Adventure As you enter, a hand-carved mahogany bar beckons. Rich brass details accent the dark wood and terrazzo floors that extend into the entire restaurant. Enjoy a hand-crafted cocktail (Key lime martini anyone?) and a bite from the bar menu available any time after 2:30 p.m. Comfy and cozy leather booths adorn one side of the bar and are available for daytime lunch dates or drinks and appetizers during dinner. Whatever you choose, attentive bartenders and cocktail servers are there to help you decide. Joe's prides itself on its outstanding service and this is proven with its staff, some with more than 30 years of experience. If a more formal dining experience is what you're looking for, head to the maître d' stand and get seated in one of the three dining rooms. If you want to be transported back to the early days of Joe's front porch dining experience, ask if you can sit in the "East Wing," the spot where the original house sat until the early 1960s. It's not outdoor dining, but if you close your eyes, you can imagine the crisp ocean breeze that would have been present as Jennie served you back in the day. Dive into Joe's Menu The menu has something for everyone. If stone crabs aren't your thing (we know - it's hard to believe), try one of the many seafood options, steaks or the award-winning fried chicken, which was once endorsed by Paula Deen and is a bargain at $8.85 for half a chicken. Lighter fare includes salads, soups or appetizers. Weekly lunch and dinner specials change every Tuesday, so you'll want to check the website regularly . Remember to save room for dessert. The Key lime pie is not to be missed. Thick, creamy and tart, the filling sits atop a hand-pressed graham cracker delicately balanced with a dollop of fresh whipped cream. Coming in a close second, Joe’s Apple Pie is a fantastic runner-up contender. Layers of sliced apples, perfectly spiced and teeming with sweetness, are topped by a pecan crumble. Have it à la mode if you dare, but you might need a partner to help you finish off this decadent dessert. If you're looking for a quick seafood fix, pick-up is what you need so just head next door to Joe’s Take Away. Stone crabs, signature items and more await. Perfect for a crunch-time meal inside or your picnic basket for the beach, Joe’s Take Away offers daily paninis, soups, specials and menu standards such as tuna bowls, salads, turkey burgers, ceviche, lobster Rueben (a must-try) and a variety of fish sandwiches. Grab a bottle of bubbly as the final accompaniment and you’ve got yourself the ideal beachside feast. When you leave Joe's, don’t despair, Joe’s can come to you! Joe’s Shipping Department ships overnight, Monday to Friday, anywhere in the country. All in all, this legendary Miami Beach restaurant is a must-see if you are visiting or just in the neighborhood, so make sure to stop by and savor what Joe’s has to offer. You’ll be happy you did! By: Lori Kahn | May 21, 2020

restaurants.name: Joia Beach Restaurant and Beach Club
restaurants.blurb: Hidden behind a picturesque pathway encompassed by lush jungle greenery and ambient lighting, sits joia beach, a day-to-night dining destination located in an exclusive enclave on Watson Island. Here, sun-drenched sands, sweeping views of Biscayne Bay and the city skyline, and vibrant pink-hued golden sunsets await. Opened in 2020 and designed by Francois Frossard, Joia beach has been hailed by Condé Nast traveler as one of "the best beaches in Miami." Described as one of the best places in Miami beach for "those craving a slick beach scene away from Miami beach’s masses," Joia beach is Miami's ultimate hidden oasis. Perfect for sunset cocktails, waterfront dinners, and weekend festivities, Joia beach has quickly become renowned as one of the best Miami Beach clubs and restaurants in the Magic City. European inspired bites and platters designed for sharing, handcrafted cocktails, and live djs and entertainment redefine south beach dining and transport you to a place of pure Joia.

restaurants.name: Komodo
restaurants.blurb: Komodo provides the allure of an ultra-chic environment paired with Pan-Asian cuisine that is second to none. Tucked away in the heart of Brickell’s financial district, this three-story indoor/outdoor restaurant seduces guests with its overstated décor all while providing a secluded escape within the bustling cityscape. The menu transports guests on an Asian adventure, seamlessly fusing classic dishes with new, innovative culinary feats. Using top-quality ingredients, each dish comes together as a work of art; teeming with flavor while maintaining visual appeal. Also noteworthy is Komodo’s handcrafted cocktail menu, available at each of the four expansive bars, including the posh, upstairs space; Komodo Lounge. The ideal space for any occasion, Komodo can accommodate private dining for large groups or intimate dinners. The venue boasts more than 300 seats including a mezzanine level, lush garden, and the venue’s most unique feature; elevated birds’ nests that create an playful treehouse feel perfect for any occasion day or night.

Guests indulge in bold, inventive dishes made with pristine ingredients and globally inspired flavors, along with craft cocktails and signature desserts. For the best brunch in Miami’s Wynwood neighborhood, KYU is the place to be!

special_offers.title: KYU Experience
special_offers.description_html:
Experience the very best of KYU Miami with the KYU Experience, an exclusive chef-curated tasting menu showcasing the restaurant's most celebrated wood-fired, Asian-inspired cuisine. Guided by KYU's signature "feed me" philosophy, this immersive dining experience highlights bold flavors, seasonal ingredients, and the innovative techniques that have made the restaurant a Miami favorite.

Enjoy a progression of the chef's most iconic dishes, from acclaimed favorites like Korean Fried Chicken and smoke-roasted specialties to inventive vegetable creations and signature desserts. Thoughtfully curated from start to finish, each course offers a memorable journey through KYU's distinctive approach to cooking over a wood-fired grill.

Price: $125 per person
How to Book: Request the KYU Experience when making your reservation or while dining at the restaurant.
Dates Offered: Available daily during Miami Spice Months
Experience Location: KYU Miami
Restrictions: Subject to availability. Reservations are recommended. Taxes and gratuity are not included.

restaurants.name: La Brisa
restaurants.blurb: Discover a world of flavor at La Brisa, the acclaimed Latin fusion restaurant inside Miccosukee Casino & Resort. Our menu, a vibrant tapestry of seasonal ingredients and global techniques, brings bold Latin American tastes to new heights. Enjoy the energy of our open kitchen from the comfortable dining room or bask in the fresh, breezy ambiance of our outdoor patio, where the unique spirit of the Everglades meets the embrace of Latin hospitality. Join us at La Brisa for an elevated dining experience unlike any other – perfect for celebrations, date nights, or gathering with friends. Executive Chef Giovanni Genao joined Miccosukee Casino & Resort on June 1, 2026, bringing more than 30 years of culinary leadership across South Florida’s luxury hotels, resorts, casinos, and convention operations. With deep experience in high-volume banquets, resort dining, and large-scale culinary systems, Chef Giovanni blends Latin roots with global influences. His approach focuses on elevating food quality, developing people, and creating memorable guest experiences through discipline, creativity, and respect for every ingredient. Mac Metzler, Beverage Manager at Miccosukee Casino & Resort, oversees the property’s beverage programming, including La Brisa and Tempt Lounge. Originally from Mississippi and now based in Miami, he brings a practical, guest-focused approach to cocktail development. For the Miami Spice menu, Mac created a coffee-inspired cocktail selection that reflects Miami’s café culture while complementing the bold Latin flavors of La Brisa.

special_offers.title: Pasta Cooking Class
special_offers.description_html:
Discover the art of handmade Italian pasta during an immersive Pasta Cooking Class at Le Specialità Café & Market by Maggio and Ignazio Cipriani. Guided by experienced chefs, you'll learn traditional techniques for crafting authentic pasta from scratch while preparing two classic Italian sauces and flavorful fillings using time-honored recipes.

Along the way, you'll gain practical culinary skills, enjoy an authentic Italian cooking experience, and take home specialty pasta-making tools and gadgets so you can recreate your favorite dishes at home.

At Mayu, we take immense pride in crafting an authentic and sophisticated culinary affair that encapsulates the essence of Peru's rich gastronomic and ancestral heritage. Our carefully curated menu features a blend of traditional Andean dishes and contemporary creations, all prepared with passion and inspiration from our homeland. Our grand opening is more than just a celebration; it's an opportunity for you to immerse yourself in the allure of the Pre-Inca culture, where every dish is a reflection of the country's diverse landscapes and historical influences. At Mayu, we have passionately woven together the finest ingredients and cooking techniques to ensure that each bite is a memorable experience. See you soon at Mayu - where Peruvian elegance comes to life!

Marion is famous for its Thursday soirees dinner party, its champagne bar and world-renowned DJs. Its cozy and upbeat setting, paired with quality service, caters to each of its guests' needs. Marion's rich, quality spices and approachable prices offer delectable dishes for all guests. Its unique character showcases European culinary wonders that will please the palate. Enjoy a pleasurable rendezvous at this sophisticated Brickell lounge where guests are sure to find an epicurean love affair and an energetic vibe. Please email: reservations@marionmiami.com for reservations or call 786-717-7512.

restaurants.name: Market At EDITION
restaurants.blurb: Jean-Georges Vongerichten's Market is an imaginative reinvention of the classic gourmet marketplace. Inspired by the great century-old Mediterranean and Italian markets, this 21st-century food bazaar is part patisserie, part boulangerie, part salumeria, offering casual, gourmet food around the clock. It features a series of bustling counters, an open-air cafe overlooking Collins Avenue and a take-out area with an enticing range of healthy international items, including gourmet pizzas, ceviche, a raw bar, charcuterie, sandwiches, juices, and a wide selection of wines.

Our menus highlight local produce and expertly grilled dishes with flavors rooted in the Sonoran Desert from Arizona, Southern California to New Mexico. Create the perfect pairing with a range of wine or agave-based cocktails featuring mezcal, tequila, and raicilla from Guadalajara and Oaxaca. restaurants.blurb: Morton's The Steakhouse, Coral Gables exemplifies class and elegance in an ideal setting. For more than 30 years this restaurant has served the finest quality food, featuring USDA prime-aged beef, fresh fish and seafood, hand-picked produce, delicious appetizers and elegant desserts. Situated on the historic Miracle Mile in The City Beautiful, Morton’s Coral Gables is surrounded by world-renowned art galleries, boutiques, and international businesses. Whether dining for lunch or dinner, guests can enjoy the intimate outdoor patio, indulge inside the main dining room, or host private events both large and small in the boardroom. Total capacity is 267, and group capacity is 66.

restaurants.name: NUNA
restaurants.blurb: Embark on a contemporary fine-dining experience at NUNA at Four Seasons Hotel Miami. Led by Chef Jaime Pesaque, whose flagship restaurant Mayta in Lima was named one of The World’s 50 Best, NUNA offers a refined exploration of Nikkei cuisine—a vibrant fusion of Japanese precision and Peruvian soul. The menu highlights bold, artfully plated dishes such as scallop and octopus ceviche in rocoto leche de tigre, chirashi-style seafood over sushi rice with aji amarillo, and the signature NUNA roll layered with tuna, avocado, and crispy shrimp. Elevated hot offerings include Wagyu and lobster saltado finished with truffled potatoes and duck confit arroz con pato enriched with foie gras and a shoyu-glazed egg yolk. Set high above the Brickell skyline, NUNA invites you to discover a masterful cultural blend in an unforgettable rooftop setting.

restaurants.name: News Cafe
restaurants.blurb: At News Cafe, every day begins with a sense of place. A gathering spot to linger over coffee, reconnect with loved ones, and watch Ocean Drive come alive, the iconic restaurant, bar, and newsstand that helped shape South Beach’s revival in the 1980s continues to operate from its original home inside The Tony Hotel at 804 Ocean Drive. Operated by Vida & Estilo Restaurant Group, News Café presents a curated Mediterranean-American menu rooted in nostalgia and designed for all-day enjoyment. Breakfast and daily brunch take center stage from the original Tony’s tomato soup, tuna melt, Aegean-Mediterranean plate, and classic eggs Benedict to indulgent French toast and Piña Colada pancakes layered with grilled pineapple and coconut syrup. It’s a menu that balances comfort and creativity, where truffle fries, a red-wine demi-glazed burger with smoked gouda, and shareable favorites keep the energy flowing from morning espresso to afternoon spritz. As the sun sets, the rhythm shifts. The Nine Edition arrives nightly from 9PM to close, an intentional late-night chapter that feels editorial, not promotional. Light bites. Easy drinks. All $9. Designed as an after-dinner ritual, it invites guests to linger a little longer with refined yet relaxed offerings. Golden, gooey Mozzarella Bites meet a glossy guava and Coca-Cola dip for a nostalgic, Miami-coded twist, while the Frozzie Rossie, a rosé-forward vodka cocktail with grapefruit sparkle, peach softness, and a delicate floral finish — delivers a crisp, modern nightcap. From sunrise brunch to after-hours bites and pours, News Café moves effortlessly through every day part, always fresh, always printed daily.

restaurants.name: Novecento Key Biscayne
restaurants.blurb: Located in the heart of Key Biscayne, Novecento blends the warmth of Argentine hospitality with Mediterranean and Pan-Latin influences to create a vibrant neighborhood dining destination. For more than 25 years, the acclaimed restaurant group has been serving signature grilled steaks, house-made empanadas, fresh seafood, handcrafted pastas and an extensive selection of wines and cocktails in a welcoming atmosphere that feels both sophisticated and relaxed. Whether you're enjoying a leisurely lunch, happy hour, weekend brunch or dinner after a day at the beach, Novecento offers something for every occasion. With indoor and outdoor seating, attentive service and a menu rooted in quality ingredients and authentic flavors, it's a favorite among both locals and visitors exploring Key Biscayne.

restaurants.name: Osaka Nikkei Miami
restaurants.blurb: Osaka, the trailblazer of the Nikkei culinary boom, has been setting the trend in this gastronomic style since its first establishment in 2001. As the original Peruvian concept, Osaka pioneers an extraordinary culinary adventure, seamlessly fusing fresh ingredients, bold spices, and masterful techniques to create a symphony of vibrant flavors. This globally acclaimed restaurant, born at the forefront of the Nikkei movement, continues to shape and define the rich and evolving tapestry of gastronomy. Nestled within Osaka, the dining experience transcends ordinary boundaries. Culinary excellence takes center stage, crafting an exquisite symphony of innovative and high-quality dishes. The bar is a realm of redefined sophistication, where signature cocktails, born from innovative mixology, elevate the unique flavors of Nikkei cuisine, creating a dynamic drinking experience. The architecture serves as a cultural bridge, seamlessly merging Japanese and Peruvian influences, utilizing traditional materials fora visually stunning backdrop. Music adds the final layer, enhancing the atmosphere with an eclectic personality, carefully chosen tunes contributing to a holistic and unforgettable dining journey at Osaka.

Gold-framed, hand-painted mirrors displaying the daily specials adorn the walls. Unique to Miami is a sprawling outdoor garden and courtyard that allows guests to enjoy the beautiful tropical weather from underneath a stunning enclosed pergola wrapped in black locust. Pastis offers crowd favorites such as Onion Soup; Escargots; a selection of Steak Frites; and the perfectly-made Cheeseburger à l’Américaine. New additions to the menu include French regional specialties like Big Eye Tuna Carpaccio dressed in lemon-leek vinaigrette, and Red Snapper Provençal that bring tastes of the South of France to Florida. Raw bar platters and bread baskets abound. And, bien sûr, what is a night out without bubbles or rose? The list of cocktails, wines, and beer will keep the celebration going all night long.

restaurants.name: Pauline
restaurants.blurb: Pauline is a coastal Miami restaurant and bar rooted in the spirit of South Florida, where Latin and Caribbean influences shape a menu inspired by the sea. Located in the heart of The Shelborne by Proper, Pauline unfolds beneath soaring windows and abundant natural light, creating an airy gathering place that moves naturally from morning coffee and lunch into cocktails, dinner, and the energy of the evening. Refined but relaxed, the menu is guided by seasonality, bright flavors, pristine seafood, and a sense of generosity. Led by Culinary Director Abram Bissell, a Florida Keys native whose career includes Michelin-starred kitchens at The Modern, NoMad, and Eleven Madison Park, Pauline brings a thoughtful, ingredient-driven approach to the flavors of the coast. The Crudo section features Cinco Conchas, conch ceviche, and Key West pink shrimp, while signature dishes such as tuna ceviche, lobster fideos, whole crispy red snapper, johnny cake, and cou-cou reflect the restaurant’s Caribbean and Latin influences through the lens of modern Miami. Named for Pauline Baker, wife and muse of celebrated cocktail writer Charles H. Baker Jr., the restaurant takes inspiration from their travels through Latin America and the glamour of Deco-era Miami. The result is a dining experience that feels open, social, transportive, and deeply connected to the rhythm of South Florida.

restaurants.name: Petralunga
restaurants.blurb: Petralunga specializes in delivering gourmet pizza with healthy whole grain dough, a pinch of gold turmeric, high quality ingredients, and a bunch of creativity! Every bite is carefully crafted and made to share like the customer favorite Cacio e Pepe Truffle pizza and Patanegra pizza with burrata stracciatella cheese. Petralunga also specializes in Roman Style Pizza, 16-inch or 12-inch size, thin and crispy. The most loved is the Brusklyn, topped with tomato sauce, garlic oil, pepperoni, stracciatella cheese, basil, hot honey and parmesan flakes. Since 2024 thin gluten-free pizza has also been available. If you’re not in the mood for pizza, the menu draws influence from the coasts of Italy with dishes like whole grilled branzino, octopus alla siciliana, tartare di tonno and pasta dishes with seafood of the day. The menu is designed with wine and cocktail pairings in mind, and Petralunga features over 150 types of tequila in the mixology bar. The environment is elegant, comfy, light and playful and includes a panoramic view of the bay and the marina of North Bay Village. Pets are also welcome. Checkout our website www.petralunga.com for our weekly offers (Pasta Lovers, Tequila Pizza Tuesday, Ladies’ Lychee Martini Night, Wine Lovers and Happy Hour) and link to reserve. We are open Monday to Friday from 5 p.m. and Saturday & Sunday from 1 p.m. Free, easily accessible parking is available, as well as free parking for boats under 45 feet (call to reserve boat spaces). Contacts: +1(305)615-6671; info@petralunga.com Instagram: @petralungamiami

restaurants.name: Piccola Pizzeria Coral Gables
restaurants.blurb: At Piccola Pizzeria, we don’t just serve Italian food—we deliver an unforgettable Italian experience. Every pizza, pasta, and signature dish is crafted from time-honored family recipes and the freshest ingredients to create flavors that keep guests coming back for more. Whether you're gathering with family, celebrating a special occasion, or enjoying a night out, you'll discover authentic Italian cuisine, exceptional service, and a vibrant atmosphere that turns every meal into a memorable event. Piccola Pizzeria brings the heart of Italy straight to your table. From handcrafted pizzas to authentic family recipes passed down through generations, every bite is packed with bold, unforgettable taste. Guests choose Piccola Pizzeria for authentic Italian dining. Our expertly crafted menu features traditional family recipes, premium fresh ingredients, and flavors inspired by the finest Italian kitchens. Whether you're sharing a meal with loved ones or enjoying a romantic evening, you'll be treated to exceptional food, welcoming service, and an atmosphere designed to make every visit special. Come hungry, leave delighted, and experience the true taste of Italy today.

restaurants.name: Platea Miami
restaurants.blurb: Experience a Peruvian-inspired take on the classic Prime Steakhouse at Platea Miami, a modern craft-steakhouse and ceviche bar curated and owned by Chef Patron Fernando Salazar & Andres Marmolejos. Featuring USDA Prime Steaks and the freshest seafood, Platea's menu offerings include an assortment of ceviches, enticing starters like the aji de gallina bites and bone marrow, salad favorites such as the Charred Ceasar and signature prime Steaks & Seafood entrees with bold Peruvian flavors that include the Prime Tomahawk, Prime Dino-Rib and Galapagos Stuffed Lobster Tail. Located in Pinecrest, Platea is open for dinner on Tuesdays to Sundays from 6 to 10 p.m.

special_offers.title: Platea Chef's Carte Blanche Experience
special_offers.description_html:
Leave the menu in the hands of the chefs during this exclusive Carte Blanche dining experience at Platea. Created by Chef Fernando and Diego Salazar, this elevated multi-course journey invites guests to enjoy a one-of-a-kind tasting menu inspired by the freshest seasonal ingredients, premium proteins, and the chefs' creativity. Each experience is uniquely crafted, allowing the culinary team to showcase their signature techniques, bold flavors, and artistic presentation, ensuring that no two dinners are ever exactly alike.

Designed for adventurous diners seeking an unforgettable evening, the Platea Chef's Carte Blanche Experience offers a personalized culinary journey that reflects the restaurant's passion for innovation and hospitality.

Price: $145 per person
How to Book: Reservations are required and may be made online through OpenTable.
Days Offered: Sundays and Mondays during Miami Spice Months
Experience Location: Platea Prime Steakhouse & Ceviche Bar
Restrictions: Available exclusively on Sundays and Mondays. Menu selections are entirely chef's choice and may vary based on seasonal availability. Reservations are subject to availability. Taxes and gratuity are not included.

restaurants.name: Rusty Pelican
restaurants.blurb: Scope out the Miami skyline over brunch, lunch or dinner at this iconic Key Biscayne waterfront eatery. Located in Rickenbacker Marina, the Rusty Pelican offers an ambiance of seaside sophistication, spectacular sunset views and a menu of contemporary cuisine with a subtle Latin twist. restaurants.name: SORA by Hotel Collection
restaurants.blurb: SORA by Hotel Collection is a sophisticated dining and lounge venue located in Miami’s Wynwood district, offering a unique blend of culinary artistry and vibrant ambiance. Immerse yourself in the authentic taste of Japan with our homemade recipes, crafted using the finest imported ingredients and served in a luxurious setting—whether you’re seated in the lounge, on the patio, or at the intimate Omakase bar. Signature dishes feature indulgent offerings such as A5 Wagyu, Toro with Caviar and Truffle, and melt-in-your-mouth salmon belly, all expertly prepared under the direction of renowned Chef Bee. The venue also hosts special events like “Caviar Wednesday” and the “Bluefin Tuna Cutting Ceremony,” providing unforgettable experiences that celebrate both tradition and innovation in dining.

special_offers.title: 140 Lbs. Bluefin Tuna Cutting Ceremony
special_offers.description_html:
Experience one of Japan's most celebrated culinary traditions during SORA's signature 140 lb. Bluefin Tuna Cutting Ceremony. This exclusive 21-and-over event offers an immersive evening where guests witness master chefs expertly break down an entire bluefin tuna before transforming it into exceptional sushi, sashimi, and hand rolls.

Your ticket includes admission, salmon appetizers, and unlimited Bluefin Tuna sushi, sashimi, and hand rolls. The evening begins with passed tuna and salmon hors d'oeuvres, followed by the live tuna cutting ceremony, showcasing the precision, artistry, and craftsmanship behind this centuries-old tradition. The experience concludes with a raffle for a $250 SORA gift certificate.

Event Schedule

  • 6:30 p.m. – Doors Open (Cocktail bar available for purchase)
  • 7:00 p.m. – Passed Tuna & Salmon Hors d'oeuvres
  • 8:00 p.m. – 140 lb. Bluefin Tuna Cutting Ceremony
  • 9:30 p.m. – $250 SORA Gift Certificate Raffle

restaurants.blurb: Perched on the 54th floor of 830 Brickell, Seia offers a refined contemporary Italian dining experience paired with sweeping views of the Miami skyline and Biscayne Bay. Inspired by the Roman goddess of growth and harvest, the restaurant celebrates seasonality through an elevated culinary philosophy that expresses a contemporary interpretation of Italian tradition. Under the culinary direction of The Bastion Collection, each dish is grounded in seasonality, shaped by craftsmanship and guided by a deep respect for ingredients at their natural peak. With a balance of precision and restraint, every plate allows the clarity of flavor and sense of place to define the experience. Open for executive lunch, aperitivo and dinner, Seia is an exceptional destination for business lunches, date nights and special occasions. Guests can enjoy handcrafted cocktails, an expertly curated wine program and seasonal menus served in an elegant setting that combines contemporary design with breathtaking panoramic views of Downtown Miami and Biscayne Bay.

restaurants.name: Sushi Bichi
restaurants.blurb: Sun, surf, sushi at Sushi Bichi, celebrating the culinary coastlines of the world’s most vibrant cultures in a beautiful, tropical Miami Beach location adjacent to the ocean in a serene, lush outdoor setting. Executive Chef Byron Alabado and Executive Sushi Chef Shoyo Iida craft meticulous sushi, fire-cooked street skewers, inventive small plates and large entrees, plus fresh raw bar, ceviches & tiraditos that echo the authenticity of Japan, The Philippines, Mexico, Peru, Brazil, Israel and The West Indies. A 360 degree bar features fresh handcrafted Bichi cocktails, premium Japanese sake, wonderful wines and Champagnes, and an international beer selection. Guests are greeted by a ceremonial Japanese torii gate - after passing through, the ordinary world is left behind, symbolically marking the transition from the mundane to the sacred. Sushi Bichi reservation bookings are subject to weather conditions.

special_offers.title: The Sushi Bichi Experience
special_offers.description_html:
Discover a one-of-a-kind chef-hosted dining experience designed for groups seeking an unforgettable evening of exceptional Japanese cuisine. Created for a minimum of four guests, The Sushi Bichi Experience begins with a personalized consultation to learn each guest's dietary preferences, allergies, and tastes before the culinary team crafts a bespoke multi-course menu.

Served family-style to encourage sharing and conversation, the experience showcases an ever-evolving selection of premium Japanese delicacies, seasonal seafood, and luxury ingredients such as A5 Wagyu, toro, Hokkaido uni, and other chef-selected specialties. Every experience is uniquely curated, ensuring no two dinners are exactly alike.

Price: $75 per person (minimum of four guests)
How to Book: Reservations are required. Please email Hayes@sushibichi.com to arrange your personalized dining experience.
Days Offered: Friday through Sunday during Miami Spice Months
Experience Location: Sushi Bichi
Restrictions: Minimum of four guests is required. The menu is customized based on guest preferences, dietary restrictions, and allergies. Advance reservations are required and subject to availability.

restaurants.name: Tacos Atarantados Brickell
restaurants.blurb: Tacos Atarantados was born in Monterrey, serving Northern Mexican tacos made with character. The trompo is its flag and the table is its meeting point. The food is meant to be shared, enjoyed, and repeated. But Tacos Atarantados is not just about flavor, it is about warm service, genuine hospitality, and tables where there is always room for one more. The restaurant believes in salsas that transform every taco and keep guests coming back for more. In Mexico, Atarantado describes that slightly dazed, distracted feeling you get when you lock eyes with a spinning trompo, when the pastor is sliced just right, and when the craving takes over. You pause. You forget what you were saying. You need that taco immediately. Real Monterrey flavor, authentic street energy, meat sizzling, and salsas that wake you up and keep you coming back, because when a taco is truly well served, happiness is guaranteed and one bite is all it takes.

restaurants.blurb: Founded by chef Tam Pham and Harrison Ramhofer, Tâm Tâm was born from a passion for bringing authentic, hard-to-find Vietnamese flavors to Miami. What began in 2019 as intimate home dinners for friends and family quickly evolved into the sold-out underground supper club, Phamily Kitchen. Following a successful residency as the first pop-up at 1-800 Lucky in 2020, Tâm Tâm gained a devoted following through acclaimed pop-ups across Miami. After refining the concept through a celebrated four-month run at Low Key in 2023, Tâm Tâm opened its flagship downtown Miami restaurant in May 2023. Today, Tâm Tâm is recognized as one of Miami’s standout dining destinations, earning a Michelin Bib Gourmand in 2024, while chef Tam Pham received the Michelin Guide’s 2024 Young Chef Award.Inspired by "quán nhậu" - Vietnamese for drinking places, Tâm Tâm is a small, loud, and lively restaurant serving chef-driven Vietnamese drinking food and wine bar. We offer a constantly changing menu with a sommelier-curated wine list along with frozen drinks and others. Located in downtown Miami, in the back of the historic Dade County courthouse.

restaurants.name: The Patio at The Joyce
restaurants.blurb: Now open along that historic tourist magnet, Española Way, is The Joyce, a steakhouse with a dark, speakeasy-esque atmosphere. It’s the first venture from the group Spicy Hospitality, which is made up of art collector Andre Sakhai, entrepreneur Marc Lotenberg and Chef James Taylor. The restaurant, located next to Paperfish Sushi, seats 45, with a sleek modern bar, and serves classic steakhouse cuisine. Taylor, who trained at Le Cordon Bleu in Chicago, has worked at three different Michelin-starred restaurants. He began his career at Bavette’s Bar & Bouef in Chicago, which has one star, then moved on to another starred restaurant, Roister, where he was executive sous chef. Later, he was chef de tournant at Alinea, which earned a coveted three-star Michelin rating. The menu at The Joyce includes seafood as well as steaks, including shrimp cocktail, crudo, a snapper filet sandwich and King Crab scampi, plus items like caviar and latkes. The cuts of meat include ribeye and A5 wagyu. But dining at The Joyce extends beyond its dimly lit walls. There’s also The Window at the Joyce, which opened in December and is also overseen by Taylor, who wanted to offer the best possible burger to customers. At The Window, diners can order more than burgers, though. The menu also includes fish and chicken sandwiches, wings, milkshakes, chopped salads and more. You can order at the window for takeout or grab a bite and sit outside on the patio and enjoy the Miami Beach breeze.

restaurants.name: True Food Kitchen
restaurants.blurb: Founded in Phoenix, Arizona, in 2008, True Food Kitchen is a restaurant and lifestyle brand inspired by the philosophy that food should make you feel better, not worse, and that great tasting food and thoughtfully crafted beverages can serve as the foundation for a life well lived. The restaurant brand is driven by a passionate collective of accomplished chefs, visionary restauranteurs, and a renowned doctor of integrative medicine – who believe delicious dining and conscious nutrition can go hand in hand, without sacrificing flavor, creativity, or indulgence. True Food’s seasonal menu is guided by the principles of Dr. Andrew Weil’s anti-inflammatory food pyramid. True Food Kitchen emphasizes wholesome, simple ingredients with simple preparations to highlight the natural health benefits and flavors of each ingredient. From nutrient-dense staples and carefully sourced proteins to little-known superfoods, True Food Kitchen is committed to sourcing the most responsible, creative, freshest, in-season ingredients. With the opening of its newest location in Miami, True Food Kitchen will have 42 locations in 17 states: including Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, Nashville, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia.

restaurants.name: Two Chefs Restaurant
restaurants.blurb: Two Chefs widely celebrated cuisine is unique-embodying and elegant restraint and a purity of ingredients seasoned with years of “Know How” that charm the palate. Chef Jan Jorgensen and his team innovate weekly menus featuring local and seasonal creations, complemented with legendary signature dishes and famous towering soufflés. Our dishes are ALL in FLAVOR and ALL MEMORABLE. All culinary guides and critics have acknowledged Two Chefs achievements since our beginning in 1994, not to mention Chef Jorgensen’s career, which began in 1980. The restaurant’s interior has been conceived as a subtle portrait, contemporary and innovate, yet mindful of tradition. The dining room allows a view of the craftsmanship kitchen, sparkled with amber glows from the wood burning oven, where skillful chefs execute clean and exciting diches-which are then delivered by a professional wait staff walking the tight rope between proper and relaxed. Our restaurant is conveniently located a short distance from Miami International Airport, popular beaches, shopping and top notch hotels-making Two Chefs a distinctive destination for custom catered private affairs, as well as lunches and dinners that are intimately crafted and served. Our casual and elegant bar offers an extensive selection or world class spirits, perfectly shaken, mixed or stirred. It’s the perfect setting for a relaxing evening with friends. Two Chefs popular cooking school is the perfect tool for team building, as well as “Just Having a Good Time”. Despite increasing changes in South Florida’s gastronomic circuit, Two Chefs retains the vibe and outlook of a serious neighborhood restaurant.

restaurants.blurb: Experience traditional Italian cuisine from the old world at the South Beach location of Via Emilia 9. Serving traditional Emilia Romagna cuisine, Via Emilia 9 showcases hand-made pastas, grass-fed meats, locally-sourced produce and the highest quality ingredients imported directly from Italy such as Parmigiano Reggiano, Prosciutto di Parma, Mortadella, balsamic vinegars and much more. The menu features an extensive selection of authentic Italian fare that includes salads, homemade flat bread sandwiches, meat/seafood/vegetable appetizers, pasta dishes like the Lamb Tortellino with Truffles and signature meat/seafood entrees such as the grass-fed Tomahawk Steak and the Mediterranean Branzino Fillet with Citrus Sauce. An onsite market carries Italian specialties such as an assortment of Italian ingredients as well as handcrafted panettone and pandoros during the holidays The restaurant serves dinner Mon-Fri from 5:00pm to 11:00pm and Sat-Sun from 12:00pm-11:00pm.

restaurants.name: Vilebrequin La Plage
restaurants.blurb: Step into the whimsical and joyful world of Vilebrequin La Plage Miami. Immerse yourself in the French Riviera lifestyle, nestled in the heart of Miami Beach at Unframed Miami Beach Hotel, part of the Autograph Collection. Savor exceptional dining at our rooftop restaurant, bar, and terrace, with options for indoor, outdoor, and poolside seating. Whether it's breakfast, apéro, dinner, or afternoon cocktails, gather with friends and appreciate a relaxed yet refined atmosphere. All this, paired with unmatched panoramic views high above Miami Beach, creates a truly unforgettable experience.
