restaurants.name: Yamashiro Miami
restaurants.blurb: Yamashiro Miami is an elevated rooftop destination on located on the 9th floor of the Gale Hotel and Residences. Our Japanese inspired design, zen garden elements, and skyline views create a multi-sensory dining experience. The menu features sushi, sashimi, makis, warm plates, and premium American and Japanese Wagyu steaks, with signature dishes like Wagyu Tomahawk, Hiramasa Ceviche, Katsu Sando, King Crab, and Specialty Cut Rolls. Our cocktail program blends Japanese flavors with tropical influences for a truly immersive experience. Perfect for in􀆟mate dinners, birthdays, corporate events, or full venue buyouts, we offer customizable menus, indoor/outdoor spaces, and elevated hospitality. Our dress code helps maintain the refined and welcoming atmosphere. We kindly ask guests to observe an elegant and contemporary style: No sportswear, shorts, sleeveless shirts, flip-flops, or hats. Please note we include a 20% service charge on all checks.

restaurants.name: ZIVA
restaurants.blurb: Enjoy masterful Mediterranean dishes crafted with premium ingredients, time-honored techniques, and a flair for modern presentation. Guests can indulge in both sharing plates and curated entrées in a chic, cosmopolitan environment. Cocktail & Lounge Vibe With thoughtfully designed cocktails and mocktails inspired by Mediterranean botanicals and flavors, Amavi delivers a seasonal sipping menu—featuring imaginative concoctions like the “Amavi Affair”—ideal for early evenings or post-dinner lounging. The space transitions beautifully from sunny brunches to energetic nights. As dusk falls, resident DJs set the tone while ambient lighting heightens the modern Mediterranean aesthetic. The setting perfectly balances social energy with visual elegance.

restaurants.name: Zaytinya South Beach
restaurants.blurb: Zaytinya at The Ritz-Carlton, South Beach, featuring an innovative mezze menu inspired by Turkish, Greek, and Lebanese cuisines, is served up in a sleek and modern setting. The menu, building on José Andrés' deep knowledge of Mediterranean cooking and years of research and travel, features shared small plates of authentic and innovative fare, along with creative cocktails and unique Mediterranean wines. Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, seven days a week, Zaytinya awaits your visit.

restaurants.name: Zuma Miami
restaurants.blurb: Experience chef Rainer Becker’s internationally renowned style of modern Japanese izakaya at Zuma, one of the recent additions to the Zuma portfolio of 15 worldwide locations that includes London, Hong Kong, Bangkok, Rome, Istanbul and New York. Ensconced in the lobby of the Kimpton Epic Hotel, Zuma offers an inventive take on traditional Japanese dishes that are meant to be shared. Guests can choose from the dinner menu of starters, robata-grilled and donburi signature entrees as well as sushi. The bold-flavored dinner menu features standouts like prawn and black cod dumplings, beef tenderloin spiced with red chili, sesame and sweet soy or a savory rice hotpot of wild mushrooms and Japanese vegetables, among others. Sake-lovers can enjoy Zuma’s impressive sake list of 80 imported varieties as well as an assortment of heritage cocktails and Japanese beers.

restaurants.name: dōma Wynwood
restaurants.blurb: Located in Miami's vibrant Wynwood neighborhood, dōma Wynwood offers an elevated take on modern Italian cuisine in an artistic setting. Helmed by Chef Davide Porcaccio, the kitchen celebrates authentic flavors with a contemporary edge—crafting standout dishes like Tagliolini al Tartufo Nero, sea salt–crusted Branzino served tableside, and house-made Pistachio Gelato. The ambiance is chic and elegant, blending refined design with Wynwood's creative energy. Perfect for date nights, special occasions, or simply indulging your love for Italian food and fine wine, dōma provides a warm, upscale experience. Wine lovers will appreciate the curated list of Italian and global vintages, thoughtfully paired with each dish. Signature cocktails—like the velvety espresso martini—add a stylish finish. Whether dining inside among modern art or relaxing on the serene patio, dōma delivers unforgettable cuisine and exceptional service in Miami.
